purpose: Phase-5D TRANSLATION CONTEXT registry. Species-keyed translation profiles binding a Phase-5C mRNA source to a protein output, with initiation/elongation/termination/folding/maturation/turnover models, evidence + uncertainty summaries, and excluded downstream functions. Consumed READ-ONLY. Human HaCaT is a set of labelled predictions; mouse + rat are NOT_REPORTED / idle (no Phase-5C mRNA, no evidence; no human fallback, no silent cross-species transfer).

global_capacity.rationale: No mTOR/PI3K suppression is present in the human HaCaT signal profile (that axis is mouse-only, 5B-M1), so global translation capacity is treated as constitutively high. A signal-node-linked capacity (e.g. mTOR suppression -> reduced capacity) is architecturally supported but NOT applied here.

out_ho1.evidence_summary: HMOX1 mRNA (5C) -> HO-1 protein: celastrol->HO-1 protein described in literature, not in the frozen package; labelled prediction.
out_ho1.uncertainty_summary: magnitude / rate / half-life NOT_REPORTED; schematic timing only.

out_nqo1.evidence_summary: NQO1 mRNA (5C) -> NQO1 protein: canonical Nrf2/ARE target translation; mechanistic prediction.
out_nqo1.uncertainty_summary: no same-context primary protein evidence; schematic timing.

out_infl.evidence_summary: Suppressed NF-kB-target mRNA (5C) -> reduced translation input -> lower schematic protein abundance.
out_infl.uncertainty_summary: schematic identity (not named ICAM1); no phenotype; schematic timing.

mouse_b16bl6.reason: Phase 5C leaves mouse transcription NOT_REPORTED (no transcription-factor node), so no mRNA exists to translate. Translation is idle; no human mRNA/protein is reused; no silent cross-species transfer.

rat_skin.reason: Phase 5C leaves rat transcription NOT_REPORTED (no cellular signaling / no mRNA). Translation is idle. Rat skin permeation evidence does NOT imply rat protein expression; nothing is copied from human HaCaT.

context_rules.one_species_one_cell_model: A translation profile binds exactly one species + cell model; never mixed.
context_rules.no_silent_transfer: Human HaCaT protein outputs are never transferred to mouse or rat. Mouse/rat stay NOT_REPORTED until Phase 5C provides a compatible mRNA profile.
context_rules.mrna_gating: Translation begins only when a valid, alive, cytoplasmic Phase-5C mRNA exists for the active context, the profile allows it, evidence is not UNAVAILABLE, and global capacity exceeds threshold.

provenance_sources: Protein outputs are labelled predictions; no rate/count/half-life/fold-change fabricated.
